title: Rate Limits
description: View request rate limits and manage exemptions for trusted users, service accounts, and networks.
accessDeniedDescription: You must be an administrator to manage rate-limit exemptions.
aboutExemptionsDescription: Exempt principals bypass rate limiting entirely. Entries marked Environment come from server configuration and are read-only here. Manual entries can be added and removed below.
currentRateLimitsDescription: Effective per-window request limits. Configured via environment variables and shown read-only.
configUnavailable: Rate-limit configuration is not available from this server.
addExemptionDescription: Exempt a user, service account, or network range from rate limiting. Use sparingly, exemptions weaken abuse protection.
exemptionsDescription: Users, service accounts, and CIDR ranges that bypass rate limiting.
exemptionsUnavailableDescription: Unable to load rate-limit exemptions. This server may not support managing exemptions through the UI yet.
removeTooltipEnv: Configured via environment variable, edit server config to change
removeDescription: {type} "{value}" will be subject to rate limits again.
